external_release_gates: Restoring the real names Noka Ramen, Son & Garden, Thai Farm Table and PeekaPlate (or naming real partners for the four new restaurants) in place of the original names needs the creator's confirmed rights to use them.
Real partner menus and prices replace the SAMPLE records in fixtures/restaurants.json once the partners supply them and grant rights.
Connecting the XR order code to the creator's Meta XR ordering app is outside this browser build.
